_defaults.style_suffix: Die-cut cartoon sticker with a clean white border, bold clean black outlines, flat colours, simple shapes, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no trademarked characters, no real people, one subject centred with nothing else around it, transparent background.

price-tag-shock.prompt: A shocked paper price tag character: a blank cream swing tag with a string loop, big round eyes wide open and a tiny open mouth, small sweat drops flying off it

buzzer-wrong.prompt: A big round red game-show buzzer button on a dark grey base, pressed down, with a bold white cross symbol on top and short impact lines around it

tick-badge.prompt: A round green badge with a scalloped edge and a bold white check mark in the middle

thumbs-down.prompt: A cartoon hand giving a thumbs-down: a plain bright yellow glove-like hand with a short blue shirt cuff

facepalm.prompt: A simple cartoon figure seen from the chest up doing a facepalm: a plain round head with no face at all, one mitten-like hand pressed over the front of the head, shoulders slumped, wearing a plain grey jumper

cash-drawer.prompt: A retro shop cash register with its drawer popping open, plain green banknotes and gold coins bouncing out, the display blank

magnifier.prompt: A magnifying glass with a chunky dark blue handle and a pale blue lens with one white shine, tilted to the right

trophy-mini.prompt: A tiny shiny gold trophy cup with two handles on a small dark base with a blank plate, two little sparkles beside it
